paper_claims.claim: SimpleMemVLA achieves 94.0% overall success on RMBench, outperforming MemoryWAM (83.0%) and all published baselines in a single multi-task model.
On RoboMME, SimpleMemVLA reaches 88.3%, leading all 21 deployable baselines by 43.7 points and nearing human performance (90.5%).
Holding the backbone and training setup fixed, native context reaches 88.3% on RoboMME whereas retrieval reaches 31.5%, token compression 22.6%, and recurrent state 20.6%.
Streaming inference prefills the shared history prefix during action execution, reducing decision latency from 1.02 s to 0.68 s within the 0.96 s budget.
Counterfactual replacement of historical cue frames redirects the policy to follow the counterfactual cue in 86%–98% of trials across suites.
On LIBERO and LIBERO-Plus, SimpleMemVLA achieves 97.5% and 78.4% success, matching or leading all general-purpose and memory baselines.
